page.overview:
What is Magnolia Crescent?

Magnolia Crescent was a street in Little Whinging, Surrey, quite close to Privet Drive. It was connected to Magnolia Road, and had an alleyway in the middle of the Crescent that connected it with Wisteria Walk.

On 6 August 1993, Harry Potter boarded the Knight Bus after accidentally inflating Marge Dursley, though not before unknowingly seeing Sirius Black in his Animagus form, a black dog.

On 2 August 1995, Harry and Dudley Dursley were attacked by Dementors in the alleyway. Harry managed to send the Dementors away with the Patronus Charm, and afterwards the two were found by Arabella Figg, who walked them home.
